parts.desc: SELECT、INSERT、UPDATE 或 DELETE，决定要读取还是修改
parts.desc_en: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE, decide whether to read or modify

parts.desc: 要操作的关系型数据集合；先确认表名和字段结构
parts.desc_en: Relational data collection to be operated; first confirm the table name and field structure

parts.desc: WHERE 限定影响范围；问号等占位符由参数化查询安全传值
parts.desc_en: WHERE limits the scope of influence; placeholders such as question marks are safely passed by parameterized queries.

use.t: 先学会用 SELECT、FROM 和 WHERE 查询目标数据，并检查返回结果
修改或删除前，先用相同的 WHERE 条件执行 SELECT，确认影响范围
使用参数化查询，让用户输入作为数据传入，而不是拼进 SQL 命令
让 AI 编写 SQL 时提供表结构，并要求它解释查询与修改范围

dont.t: DELETE 缺少 WHERE 时会删除表中所有行；执行前必须确认范围并准备恢复方案
不要把表单内容直接拼进 SQL，这会产生 SQL 注入风险
不要在生产数据库中边猜边试；先在测试数据或事务中验证
不要只设计展示文案，还要为数据定义稳定标识和合适字段类型

lessonPractice.title: 要查“当前用户自己的未完成任务”，哪种查询边界更安全？

options.label: 按当前用户和未完成状态筛选，并只取页面需要的字段
options.feedback: 对。查询条件同时限定归属和状态，避免读取无关或他人的数据。

options.label: 先查全部任务，再由前端隐藏不属于当前用户的行
options.feedback: 数据已经被发到客户端，前端隐藏不能保护访问边界。

options.label: 只要加未完成条件，使用 SELECT * 没关系
options.feedback: 即使行范围正确，也不应无必要地取回敏感或不用的字段。

en.title: For a current user’s incomplete tasks, which SQL boundary is safer?

options.label: Filter by current user and incomplete status, returning only fields the page needs
options.feedback: Correct. The query limits ownership and state so it does not read unrelated or other users’ data.

options.label: Query every task and hide other users’ rows in the browser
options.feedback: The data is already sent to the client; hiding it there does not protect access.

options.label: Use SELECT * as long as incomplete status is filtered
options.feedback: Even with correct rows, do not return sensitive or unused fields without need.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 任务列表接口请只查询当前用户的未完成任务，并返回页面实际使用的字段。用两个用户的数据测试：每人只能看到自己的未完成项，响应中不应包含不需要的敏感列。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Make the task-list endpoint query only the current user’s incomplete tasks and return only fields used by the page. Test with two users’ data: each must see only their incomplete items, and the response must omit unnecessary sensitive columns.

comparison.title: SQL 和 NoSQL 有什么区别？
comparison.decision: SQL 是查询语言；实际选型是在关系型数据库与某种具体的 NoSQL 数据库之间比较。重点看数据关系、访问方式和一致性要求，不是简单判断谁更快。

dimensions.label: 数据组织
dimensions.current: 用表保存结构化记录，并通过字段关联不同表中的数据
dimensions.other: 按文档、键值、列族或图等不同模型组织数据

dimensions.label: 判断重点
dimensions.current: 需要多表关联、字段约束和事务时，通常更直接
dimensions.other: 数据模型和访问方式很明确时，可选择针对该模式设计的产品

dimensions.label: 适用场景
dimensions.current: 订单、账户和其他关系明确、需要一致性的业务数据
dimensions.other: 键值缓存、文档内容、事件记录或图关系等特定场景

scenario.title: 保存一笔电商订单
scenario.text: 一笔订单要同时关联用户、库存和支付记录时，关系型数据库通常更直接。如果数据主要按设备 ID 大量写入和读取日志，专门的键值或文档数据库可能更合适。NoSQL 种类差异很大，仍要按具体产品和实际负载验证。

dont.t: Concatenate untrusted input into a query
Select every column when only a few are needed
Run an unbounded update or delete
Assume a database permission replaces application authorization

comparison.title: SQL vs NoSQL: which fits your data?
comparison.decision: SQL is a query language; the actual choice is between a relational database and a specific NoSQL database. Compare them by data relationships, access patterns, and consistency needs—not by assuming one is faster.

dimensions.label: Data structure
dimensions.current: Stores structured records in tables and connects related data through fields.
dimensions.other: Uses models such as document, key-value, wide-column, or graph.

dimensions.label: Decision point
dimensions.current: Often the direct fit when joins, constraints, and transactions matter.
dimensions.other: Can fit a well-defined data model and access pattern with a purpose-built product.

dimensions.label: Typical fit
dimensions.current: Orders, accounts, and other related business records that need consistency.
dimensions.other: Key-value caches, documents, event records, or graph relationships.

scenario.title: Creating an e-commerce order
scenario.text: When an order connects customer, inventory, and payment records, a relational database is often the direct fit. If logs are mainly written and read by device ID at high volume, a purpose-built key-value or document database may fit better. NoSQL products differ widely, so test the specific product against the real workload.
